content.text: In Nigeria, where Gumroad is restricted, and Stripe is unreliable, digital creators face infrastructure hurdles that compromise their online presence and revenue streams. To bypass these limitations, a sovereign commerce infrastructure approach is needed, where creators have full control over their digital products and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-broken-here-infrastructure|Payment Gateways]] processing, without relying on centralized platforms like PayPal, Stripe, or Gumroad. This breakdown explores the architecture of a crypto payment gateway for digital products, built on NOWPayments, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, and how it can be used to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-complete-infrastructure-guide-2|ebooks]], courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, without platform fees or restrictions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

This sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround for platform restrictions but a base-layer solution that empowers digital creators to build and deploy their own online stores, with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. By using NOWPayments as the payment gateway, creators can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT, with a 0.5% fee, and no KYC or buyer account requirements. This architecture is designed to be scalable, secure, and reliable, making it an attractive option for creators who want to break free from platform limitations and take control of their digital commerce.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture relies on Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is integrated with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and automatic webhook fires the moment payment confirms on-chain, ensuring seamless product delivery and payment processing. The system is designed to be modular, allowing creators to add or remove components as needed, making it a flexible and adaptable solution for digital commerce.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This sovereign commerce infrastructure is built for digital creators who want to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, without relying on centralized platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. It's ideal for creators who want to take control of their digital commerce, reduce platform fees, and increase revenue streams. The architecture is particularly useful for creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad is restricted or unreliable, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, or Zimbabwe.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% commission, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee, making it an attractive option for digital creators who want to maximize their revenue streams.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this sovereign commerce infrastructure include NOWPayments for payment processing, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Additionally, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are used for hosting, and the system is integrated with automatic webhook for seamless payment processing and product delivery. The architecture is designed to be modular, allowing creators to add or remove components as needed.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this sovereign commerce infrastructure today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, and instant download. The kit provides everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Once the kit is downloaded, creators can follow the instructions to deploy their infrastructure, configure their payment gateway, and start selling their digital products. Shop for the Complete Builder Kit at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

The fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments can be substantial, with NOWPayments charging only 0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10% commission. This means that at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, a creator can retain an additional $921 by using NOWPayments. This is a significant advantage for digital creators who want to maximize their revenue streams.

Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does NOWPayments handle cryptocurrency pricing in USD?
NOWPayments uses real-time cryptocurrency pricing to convert transactions to USD at the time of payment, ensuring that creators receive the correct amount for their digital products.
What are the benefits of using Cloudflare Workers for backend logic?
Cloudflare Workers provide a scalable and secure solution for handling backend logic, allowing creators to focus on building their digital products without worrying about infrastructure management.
How does Supabase store orders for digital products?
Supabase uses a robust and scalable database to store orders for digital products, ensuring that creators have access to accurate and up-to-date order information.
Can creators use their existing infrastructure with this sovereign commerce architecture?

Yes, creators can integrate their existing infrastructure with this architecture, allowing them to build on their existing setup and take advantage of the benefits of a sovereign commerce infrastructure.
What are the system requirements for deploying this sovereign commerce infrastructure?

Creators need to have a basic understanding of infrastructure setup and deployment, as well as access to a cloud hosting provider like Cloudflare or Google Cloud, to deploy this sovereign commerce infrastructure.
